propositions: A transient GitHub git fetch hang exceeds _GIT_TIMEOUT (300s) and converts to SnapshotFetchError, which adapter.code_review_decision treats as a review fault and returns BLOCK instead of ABSTAIN
The BLOCK vote is posted as durable LLM-Review -1, which reconcile.py's has_llm_review_vote filter treats as voted and removes from backfill re-eligibility forever

Retryable infrastructure faults (SnapshotFetchError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, TimeoutError, ConnectionError) should not vote and should leave the change eligible for backfill retry, matching the outer no-vote safety net already in app.py and reconcile.py
The voter must distinguish retryable infrastructure faults from genuine review conclusions and route faults to a no-vote ABSTAIN path with a VOTER_ERROR marker instead of fail-closed -1
An abstained change must remain vote-less to allow reconcile.py backfill pre-filters to re-pick it on the next pass
